name: mb_jmppair
max_insn_note: Cover the complete 5,204-instruction program: 1 setup + 200 * 26 loop instructions + 3 exit instructions. The old 5,000 cap cut a U/V pair mid-loop: the clock-boundary RTL stop retained 5,001 real retirements while QEMU stopped at 5,000. Verify through the actual terminal INT; never trim a trace or disable pairing to align the cap.
m5_band: INFO regression: unconditional short JMP (EB) is V-pairable; `mov; jmp` groups pair (mov U, jmp V); abs-cyc tracks the oracle
note: Regression for finding [med] EB JMP V-pairing. p5model classifies JMP as PV/pairs_second. M5 makes the RTL pair `<UV op>; jmp` and charges an unconditional-jmp mispredict as 3, so the abs-cyc tracks the p5model golden.
